restrictions: Published nominal rates require declared tax and real-price conversion before constant-currency model use.
No national zone/cohort weights inferred; no simple average treated as observed national tariff.
Wind2009 does not specify support lifetime; PV20years is in principle, not a universal permit guarantee.
Earlier approvals, monthly cutoffs and commissioning deadlines require cohort state, not just a calendar-year policy switch.
These two vintages do not supply the entire2015-2024 policy sequence or current S0 policy.
The model currently has no distributed-PV self-consumption/export topology or fiscal arrears financing; those paths are not admitted by this extraction.
